name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_slice < 'a > (self) -> Option < & 'a [MaybeUninit < T >] >
rule: If self is non-null, adding self.len() * size_of::<T>() bytes to its data pointer must not wrap around the address space, even if the result of as_uninit_slice is unused.
